English.Char_Desc_250: ReviveFix checks the network drives, NAS folders and printers on a Windows PC with one button. It reconnects dropped drives, resumes paused printers and clears stuck print queues, and explains in plain words what it cannot fix.
English.Char_Desc_450: ReviveFix is a free, portable Windows tool for when a network drive, NAS folder or printer stops working. One button checks them all. It reconnects drives that show a red X, resumes paused printers, turns off “Use printer offline”, starts the print spooler and clears a stuck print queue after asking. When it cannot fix something, it explains why in plain words, and “Copy for IT” gives your IT staff the details.
English.Char_Desc_2000:
ReviveFix is a free Windows tool for when a network drive, NAS folder or printer suddenly stops working on an office PC. Click one button. You do not need to know what is broken.
It checks the drives connected to the PC, any folder address you type in, and every printer. It reconnects network drives that show a red X in File Explorer, resumes paused printers, turns off “Use printer offline”, starts the print spooler, and, after asking you first, restarts the spooler to clear a stuck print queue. Each line shows whether something works, was fixed, can be fixed after you confirm, or needs your IT staff.
When a folder will not open, ReviveFix tells you why: the server name cannot be found, the server cannot be reached, the shared folder does not exist, your account has no permission, or the saved password no longer works. It never lowers security settings, never asks for or reads passwords, and never sends anything over the internet. “Copy for IT” puts the details on the clipboard for whoever manages the NAS or printer.
One exe file, no installation (about 8 MB), available in 11 languages. Free, no ads. It starts without administrator rights; Windows asks only when a fix needs them.
